name: Recas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided purple over green with a yellow triangle at the hoist bearing an olive tree.
history: The description of the municipal flag was approved at the same time as the arms and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 13 March 1991: a flag divided by a triangle at the hoist, the upper stripe purple, the lower green and the triangle next to the hoist yellow, with an olive tree in its natural colours at its centre.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
olive tree in its natural colours on the triangle
